title_as_printed: Measured Vapor Pressure of Water, P, at the Equilibrium Temperature, T, Calculated Values of the Activity of Water in the Liquid Phase, a_w, and the Osmotic Coefficient, phi, at Different Molalities m
pressure_note: total measured pressure at equilibrium in a degassed cell; text: 'The salt is not volatile, so the total measured pressure at equilibrium P is the vapor pressure of water' (absolute, 0-1000 Torr manometer)

value2.what: activity of water, P-based, calculated by authors with virial correction (eq 4)

value3.what: osmotic coefficient, molality scale, calculated by authors from a_w

composition.other_species: binary H2O + NaCl; molality in mol/kg of water, set per label row (constant NaCl)

notes: Printed as two side-by-side column groups per molality block; stacked left group first, then right group (rows in increasing T within each group; the right group continues the temperature sequence). Composition from vibrating-tube density; accuracy +/-0.001 mol/kg. Printed 299.2 (m=2.200, first T of second row) kept as printed (likely 299.20).
